name: unifood-platform
description: UniFood Campus Food Delivery and Restaurant POS Platform

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix backend install --include=dev && npm --prefix customer-app install --include=dev && npm --prefix desktop-app install --include=dev
scripts.build: npm --prefix backend run prisma:generate && npm --prefix customer-app run build && npm --prefix desktop-app run build && npm --prefix backend run build
scripts.build:cloud: npm run install:all && npm run build
